subject: Testcase Tradecraft — MPA, transfer constraints & closure runway
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@mavenretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@mavenretail.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcases for pilot — initial package attached

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a zipped package of our initial testcases (maven_testcases_v1.zip). A couple of framing notes so we can make the pilot productive: 

- What we share is a curated slice (2.4k examples) from our proprietary QA corpus.
- Usage constraints we need: no redistribution outside Redwood, no sub-licensing, and deletion from any non-Redwood-controlled storage after the pilot (we suggest 90 days).
- PII has been redacted but some entries contain fuzzy user identifiers — treat them as sensitive.
- We expect the asset to be used for model-quality evaluation only (rank/accuracy/response-sanity). No external benchmarking publication without permission.

Can you confirm Redwood's standard MAP/MPA process and whether we need an NDA addendum for the PII note? Also: we'd like an ephemeral sandbox to run the promptpack; can you confirm token retention/kv-cache policy for ephemeral runs?

Attachments: maven_testcases_v1.zip (zip)

Cheers,
Elliot Price
Head of ML Ops, Maven Retail
elliot.price@mavenretail.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

On Tue, Jul 21, 2026 at 09:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the packet — looking forward to getting this started.
>
> — Grace
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@mavenretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcases for pilot — initial package attached

Elliot —

Appreciate the context and the package. Quick read-through from our legal/compliance and product teams; below is a proposed operational MAP to get the sandbox and acceptance window aligned. Attaching a draft MPA (mpa_draft_20260803.pdf) that captures these bullets.

High-level proposal (two-phase):
- Phase 1 — Sandbox run (ephemeral): Aug 10–14. Redwood will host a sandbox stage (private tenant) using Dedicated pilot capacity. Access is scoped to 4 named engineers from Maven.
- Phase 2 — Acceptance gate: Aug 15–17. Maven will validate model outputs against the provided testcases and shared acceptance prompts. If acceptance passes, we proceed to a short production evaluation (limited tokens) before contract close.

Required constraints (Redwood side — please confirm):
- Ephemeral storage: testcases and derived artifacts will be kept on sandbox hosts only and scheduled for deletion 90 days after access unless otherwise agreed.
- No third-party hosting: assets must not be mirrored to non-Redwood infrastructure.
- Audit logging: request/response logs for the sandbox runs will be retained for 30 days and made available to Maven on request; logs redact full PII by default.
- Promptpack handling: promptpacks must be stored in an access-restricted vault; we will not surface raw prompt templates externally.

A couple of asks for your team:
1) Provide the list of named Maven engineers (emails) who should be granted sandbox access.
2) Confirm whether Maven requires any additional contractual language for the PII redaction note — legal can loop in an NDA addendum if needed.

We've left a margin in the MPA draft for your comments and a small schedule for signature (DocuSign link TBC). If these high-level bullets look OK I can loop Karthik (technical lead for Dedicated) to confirm runtime constraints and Ben for the acceptance criteria.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: mpa_draft_20260803.pdf (pdf)
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@mavenretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@mavenretail.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcase Tradecraft — MPA, transfer constraints & closure runway

Grace —

This looks good and aligned with how we usually run pilots. Quick answers and a small request: 

- Named engineers for access: sara.lin@mavenretail.com, petra.james@mavenretail.com (Petra is our lead data engineer).
- PII addendum: yes, we prefer a short NDA addendum that references the redaction caveat and sets the 90-day deletion baseline. Legal can draft, but if you have standard language that speeds this up we can use it.
- Promptpack question: our sample promptpack includes a small number of zero-shot tests that we may want to run against the same prompt templates used in production. Can Redwood confirm that promptpack templates will be preserved only for acceptance scoring and will not be exported in full from the sandbox?

I've also attached a tiny text file with 12 example prompts for your eval team to sanity-check (maven_sample_prompts_v1.txt).

If everything above is OK we're ready to move to signature. Could you confirm whether Dedicated pilot capacity is required for the sandbox or whether Hosted with strict tenancy rules suffices? We prefer Dedicated but can be flexible.

Thanks,
Elliot
Head of ML Ops, Maven Retail

Attachment: maven_sample_prompts_v1.txt (txt)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@mavenretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcase Tradecraft — MPA, transfer constraints & closure runway

Elliot —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the named engineers. Confirming the next steps and a compact runway: 

- Legal: I'll attach Redwood's standard PII addendum language into the MPA today; if Maven legal wants alternate phrasing we'll iterate but this should be the fastest path.
- Environment: We will provision Dedicated pilot capacity for the sandbox to match the resource isolation you requested. Karthik (cc) will confirm the exact GPU footprint and an account alias for your team by Friday Aug 6.
- Promptpack handling: agreed — prompt templates will be preserved in a vault accessible only to the named Maven users and will not be exported from Redwood systems. Acceptance scoring tooling will reference templates but raw templates won't be shared externally.

Proposed timeline (final):
- Aug 6: DocuSign/MAP countersign (we'll send the envelope).
- Aug 10: Sandbox access granted — initial run window Aug 10–14.
- Aug 15–17: Acceptance validation period.
- Aug 18–20: Short production evaluation (if acceptance passes).

Action items: 
- Maven: countersign the MPA once you review; confirm Petra's email for access.
- Redwood: Karthik will share the Dedicated host specs and an onboarding checklist; Neha will coordinate audit log access.

I've added a HubSpot note and will push the DocuSign envelope after we get Petra's email. HubSpot/DocuSign links are in the related links field for your reference.
